reuse_policy: Reuse any actual cached case whose complete input/solver/claim identity matches; compute only missing or materially invalidated cases

classification_rules.requires: A valid bound B_O for the named consumer observable/domain, including declared uncertainty, satisfies B_O <= epsilon_HH
An admitted lower bound on |Delta_HH O| exceeds the predeclared epsilon_HH
Upper bound exceeds epsilon but lower bound does not, or a concrete scientific question requests the HH response
classification_rules.ceiling: No materiality claim from an upper bound alone

classification_rules.requires: Consumer identity, domain, threshold, source owner or valid local-to-history transfer missing
classification_rules.ceiling: No inference of negligible effect and no complete atomic rerun

local_PHYS12_premise_for_reuse: Exact matching or separately established source-family coverage; full/first_half are not history samples
